# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 54 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 40 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_054_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 54

**1** Jesus said: "How fortunate are the poor — the kingdom of heaven is yours."

---

**Translation Notes (PNEUMA):**
- "How fortunate" — the beatitude rendered as exclamation
- "Is yours" — the present possession emphasized
- The saying is brief; its simplicity is its power

---
